notes.title: 1.0.6 - Lighting, Performance, and Shop Fixes
notes.content:
- Performance passes over the level lighting.
- Fixed a potential softlock where the player summons an item (most commonly a desk) from the shop, but does not zoom out to be able to interact with it.
- Removed floating items in some rolls of the Conservatory.

Stay cozy, Arcanists!

notes.title: 1.0.5 - Saving Unlocks & Tutorial Updates!
notes.content:
- NEW DILEMMA! A competitor is casting hexes on your Conservatory... and throwing all your apprentices into the sky!
- Unlocked Stations & Decor are permenant, rather than per-run.
- Completing the tutorial and follow-up helper pop-ups once will make them hidden forever. Can be shown again by pressing "Reset Tutorials" in the main menu.
- Skipping the tutorial will also hide some early popups.
- Solved a rare crash related to [i]capes[/i]. (Edna was right..)

notes.title: 1.0.4 - Localization & font fixes
notes.content:
- Fixes to Korean localization & font placement.
- Infinite Levitation no longer makes apprentices hidden but not dead.
- Fix for camera getting stuck outside the Conservatory.

notes.title: 1.0.3 - Frogs, Sounds, & Saves !
notes.content:
- Balcony outside the Commonroom properly claims its Stations and Decor.
- Frog-Apprentices that die properly notify the player about the death and take Influence/App Debt.
- Frog-Apprentices no longer show up in the apprentice overview panel.
- Mind Control does not hang when the controlled apprentice dies.
- Overlapping items in Artifact Storage fixed.
- New sound effects.
- Performance tweaks.
- Playtime & achievement stats now save to long-term, cloud storage.
- Early random event for frogs.

notes.title: 1.0.2 — Dilemma & Save Game Hotfix.
notes.content:
- A number of performance-related optimizations.
- Graphical errors on the front of the Conservatory.
- Savegame functionality on certain storage disk hardware fixed.
- Additional player stats tracked in the save file.

Happy researching, my fellow Arcanists!

notes.title: Update 0.5.0.3
notes.content:
My dear apprentices,

Demo version 0.5 releases with a new tutorial (we heard you, too much text!), a guide and library for players to find specific things they're confused on, and tons of new visual effects! Arcanum (money) has also been rebalanced, you will now have to save [i]one[/i] or [i]two[/i] apprentices to build a successful Conservatory.

Unless you succumb to war profiteering. 

Good luck!
The High Arcanist.

notes.title: Fool's Apprentice Demo now released!
notes.content:
The Fool's Apprentice now has a public demo! Start your magical studies today! Though there is much hidden away for the full game, TFA is fully featured, allowing you to collect, train, and cast spells on your hopelessly unskilled apprentices. Please share it around to any who'd enjoy the game, and have fun!

We're on track for a release early this spring, so you won't have to wait long to build out the magic academy of your dreams! 


Features in this version of the demo:

[list]
[*] Upgradable Stations
[*] Six narrative Dilemmas
[*] Full shop & gameloop
[*] Magic to cast on foolish apprentices!
[/list]

Features coming soon :

[list]
[*] Additional visual effects for stations, the Runic Viewing, graduation, and ambient magical effects.
[*] Additional music soundtracks.
[*] Additional Stations
[*] Additional mechanics for apprentice traits
[*] Dozens of decorative elements to spruce up your very own Conservatory!
[i]and lastly...[/i]
[*] The Portalsmithing Chamber will be added to a future version of the Demo!
[/list]


Features withheld for the full game :

[list]
[*] Upgradable Conservatory & Rooms
[*] Research mechanics and long-term upgrades (& savegames!)
[*] Remaining 4 Conservatory Rooms
[*] Dozens of additional Dilemmas, stations, apprentice traits, and the like!
[/list]

notes.title: The Fool's Apprentice - Closed Playtests
notes.content:
[h2]Hello Steam![/h2]

We are running a closed playtest for The Fool's Apprentice here on Steam!

Here is what you need to know:
[list]
[*] The playlist will run for 2-3 days this coming week.
[*] You can 'Request access' and you’ll get notified if and when you are selected. There may be a second wave of playtest immediately before the demo launch, and additional rounds will come for the full game.
[*] Please do not record or stream gameplay footage of the game at this time (feel free to once the demo is out)
[*] The public demo is planned to release a week after playtests are run so if you are not invited to this weekend, worry not! You will soon have a Conservatory of your own.
[/list]

Thanks and have a wonderful day,
- The Planar Danse
